entities.name: Maralen of the Mornsong
entities.description: A Mornsong elf of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, handmaiden to Peradala, who died and was replaced by a faerie impostor.

entities.name: Maralen (faerie impostor)
entities.description: A faerie created by Oona with Maralen's appearance and memories who now rules from Glen Elendra, and who developed individualism and defied her creator.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Where the great faerie Maralen now rules.

entities.name: Mornsong
entities.description: An elvish tribe known for amethyst, jet and sapphire attire.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: An elvish tribe with ram-like horns.

entities.name: Peradala
entities.description: The perfect Mornsong bride whose convoy was massacred.

entities.name: Eidren of Lys Alana
entities.description: Groom of Peradala in a union to unite the Mornsong and Gilt-Leaf.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Faerie queen who had the wedding party attacked and replaced Maralen with a faerie.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf elf given the moonglove to use against the new Maralen if needed.

entities.name: Moonglove
entities.description: Substance Maralen harvested, instrumental in Oona's defeat.

events.summary: In 4520 AR Maralen accompanies Peradala's wedding convoy, which would have united the Mornsong and Gilt-Leaf tribes.
events.quote: served as a handmaiden to the perfect Peradala and accompanied her wedding convoy

events.summary: The convoy is massacred by a swarm of faeries and vines; only Maralen survives, defending herself with moonglove.
events.quote: The entire party was massacred gruesomely, save for Maralen

events.summary: Oona questions Maralen as vines overwhelm her; the real Maralen dies and is replaced by a faerie impostor.
events.quote: The real Maralen died then, and she was replaced by a faerie imposter by Oona .

events.summary: The impostor develops individualism and defies Oona; the moonglove helps defeat Oona and is given to Rhys.
events.quote: The moonglove that Maralen harvested before her death was instrumental in Oona's defeat.

relations.quote: an elf named Maralen served as a handmaiden to the perfect Peradala
she was replaced by a faerie imposter by Oona
